title: Klint Kubiak: We're counting on Ashton Jeanty for Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Klint Kubiak: We're counting on Ashton Jeanty for Week 1
sources.description: The Raiders wrapped up their preseason games on Thursday night and running back Ashton Jeanty's status will be one of the team's focal points as they turn their attention toward Week 1.
